    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted" name="Inspection completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ResultToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToMachineData" sourceRef="StartEvent_InspectionStart" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineData"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MachineDataToQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineData" targetRef="Task_AnswerQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_QuestionsToButton" sourceRef="Task_AnswerQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressButton"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ButtonToCollect" sourceRef="Task_PressButton" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectToResultGateway" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResultToAdditionalQuestions" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ResultToEnd" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalToEnd" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
